freeze_rule: On first ingestion of a post-lock public release, compute probabilities from strictly earlier completed release events and persist them immutably before outcome scoring.
evaluation_rule: Score only immutable frozen predictions for release events whose public actual release timestamp is strictly after locked_at. Never recompute model probabilities for scoring. Require release <= frozen_at < reaction outcome availability; reject unverified or late-frozen rows.
promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. A new policy epoch must be created explicitly after reviewing genuinely out-of-sample results.
note: Epoch 3 fixes completed-outcome visibility in analog histories. Epochs 1 and 2 remain historical provenance; their frozen rows are not rewritten. Session-close availability is an estimate, not verified provider arrival.
